question: Q7/H7
trigger_or_metric: APTINDO projection of national wheat flour consumption for 2026 and stated 2025 outcome (Fortune IDN)
ref_period: Calendar year 2026 projection; 2025 as stated by outlet
proxy_note: Single-outlet report of an APTINDO figure; not confirmed elsewhere
snippet: memperkirakan konsumsi tepung terigu nasional pada 2026 mencapai 7,82 juta ton [...] naik 5 persen secara tahunan dibandingkan dengan realisasi 2025 yang sebesar 7,41 juta ton
notes: CONFLICT: CNBC (S5, Mar 2025) attributes 7.41 Mt to full-year 2024, and USDA (S2) reports Jan-Nov 2025 at 7.09 Mt (+4.87%). The two readings are not reconcilable without the APTINDO release: if 7.41 were the 2025 total, December 2025 would be 0.32 Mt (7.41 minus 7.09), well below the monthly pace of Jan-Nov. Treat the "2025 = 7.41" label as unresolved and the 2026 projection as weak until APTINDO is opened. Also 7.82/7.41 is +5.5%, the article says 5 percent.
